segments.comment: Abandoned A36 variation retained with its matching recording: C normalizes the invalid Healer/elf/chaotic combination to a neutral human Healer, the leading space is consumed as an unknown command, and the final . remains at the blind quick-glance --More-- boundary. It is admission-only and does not establish a selected location. The valid selected-location variation is retained separately as blind-glance-description-blocked-variation.session.json, blocked by the existing JS ttyPutmixed versus C putmixed(WIN_MESSAGE) owner.
